author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Cisco Talos uncovered msaRAT, a Chaos ransomware RAT that hides C2 traffic by routing it through Chrome or Edge using the Chrome DevTools Protocol. Cisco Talos disclosed msaRAT, a Rust-based remote access trojan attributed to the Chaos ransomware group that routes its entire command-and-control channel through the victim’s own Chrome or Edge browser. title: Chaos ransomware deploys browser-based msaRAT to evade network detection

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Check Point addressed a critical authentication bypass flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-16232, in SmartConsole that is being actively exploited. title: Check Point patches actively exploited SmartConsole authentication bypass flaw
